order.title: Order
order.intro: The NIS 2 guided pass for one year, {price} net. One payment covers every organization and user on your account. You pay by invoice within 30 days, and access opens as soon as you order. If you cancel within 30 days of ordering, you get your money back.
order.sandboxNotice: Test mode: this order creates an invoice in the Qonto sandbox and unlocks this account.
order.alreadyPaid: Your account is paid until {date}, invoice {number}.
order.payerOnly: The account holder can place the order. Usually that is whoever set up the organization.
order.pendingCheck: We are checking an earlier order for this account. Please do not order again; we will get back to you.

form.recipientDescription: The invoice is made out to the company. Where it is sent is set further down.
form.companyNameHint: Exactly as registered. We cannot check it for you, because the EU VAT register does not disclose German company names.
form.vatHint: Decides the VAT on the invoice.
form.deliveryDescription: In most companies the invoice goes to accounting, not to the person ordering.
form.purchaseOrderHint: Many companies only pay an invoice that carries their own reference.

registry.unavailable: Register unreachable, which holds nothing up

warnings.notInRegister: The EU register does not know this number yet, which is normal for a newly issued one. It does not hold up the order.

treatment.reverse_charge: Reverse charge: you account for the VAT yourself.
treatment.unconfirmed_eu: Reverse charge needs a number the EU register has confirmed. This one is not confirmed yet, so the invoice carries German VAT.
treatment.outside_eu: Supplied outside Germany for VAT purposes, so no German VAT.

errors.companyName: The registered company name goes on the invoice.
errors.countryCode: Two-letter country code, for example DE.
errors.vatFormat: That does not look like a VAT number. It starts with the country code.
errors.vatChecksum: A digit in that number is wrong. Check it against your tax office letter.
errors.vatCountry: That does not match the VAT number format of that country.
errors.email: An address the invoice can be sent to.

result.title: Ordered
result.body: Invoice {number} for {gross} reaches {email} within a few minutes. Payable by {dueDate}. Your access is open.
result.alreadyOrdered: This account already has a current invoice. You find it under your invoices.
result.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
result.failed: The order could not be completed just now. Please try again later.
result.priceChanged: The EU register answered differently just now, so the price changed. Please check the new amount, then order again.
result.unknown: We could not tell for certain whether the invoice was created. Please do not order again. We will check and get back to you.

page.title: Billing
page.description: Your account's access, price and invoices.

level.grandfathered: Early account: the current journey stays free for you

page.payerOnly: The account holder sees the invoices. Usually that is whoever set up the organization.
